request: Five game-selection UI concepts: original emerald/gold brand colors, minimal graffiti, existing layout/grid preserved.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity UI design example of the GAME SELECTION PAGE ONLY for Thai app "วงเซียน", NOT a gameplay screen, NOT a speedometer screen. Make a large crisp landscape comparison board with desktop screenshot left (74 percent width) and mobile portrait screenshot right (26 percent), flat screens without device shells. Reference 1 is the ACTUAL CURRENT selection page: preserve its layout, grid, card order, relative proportions and artwork closely. Reference 2 is an earlier responsive selection mockup for hierarchy only; do NOT copy its wrong flower logo or extra crab/fish game. Reference 3 is the official gold/cream yin-yang gaming logo, use exactly this emblem. Restore ORIGINAL brand palette: dark emerald forest green page backdrop (#071f18 to #174d37), deeper green panels, subtle green borders, cream primary text, warm gold #efc758 accents. Logo gold and cream, exact Thai wordmark "วงเซียน" in gold, small "MINI GAME CLUB" gold. NOT grayscale, not black/red theme. Header brand at top left, profile "Player", sound and settings icons at top right; thin divider below. Heading "เลือกเกมของคุณ", subheading "เลือกเกม แล้วมาเล่นด้วยกัน". Four rounded filter tabs in same place/order: "ทั้งหมด", "อาร์เคด", "เกมไพ่", "ปาร์ตี้"; active tab gold with dark text. One full-width featured Road Fighter card under filters, colorful pixelated gray road/bright green grass/red car preview on left and title/description/player badges/gold "เริ่มเล่น" button on right. Desktop regular cards beneath are precisely THREE equal columns with stable gaps: row1 "ป๊อกเด้ง" (2–10 คน), "Poker" (2–6 คน), "Spyfall" (3–8 คน); row2 "อีแก่กินน้ำ" (3–8 คน), "Who am I" (3–8 คน), "ไพ่ตอแหล" (2–6 คน); row3 "Undercover" (3–8 คน) leftmost. Preserve same image-over-title card proportions and artwork style as actual screenshot: cream playing cards, blue spy silhouette, old maid cards, identity portraits, hidden cards, undercover characters. No new games. Mobile: same header and four tabs, featured card image above copy, TWO columns of regular cards, same order, compact readable labels. This is a cosmetic theme refresh, do not rearrange grid, add sidebar, leaderboard, banners, large hero copy, gauges or gameplay controls. Add MINIMAL graffiti only to empty background and header corners, very restrained low opacity, never behind readable text or covering cards, no extra graffiti words/slogans. Calm polished professional interface with enough quiet negative space. Gold CTA and fine gold featured-card outline; natural green card backgrounds. Small design-number label outside the app UI.
EXAMPLE 1 "01 · GOLD STROKES": Closest to original. Minimal warm gold spray-painted paired brush strokes in the empty upper-right intro area where the original red diagonal stripes were; a few tiny speckle dots and one curved spray line in outer bottom corners. Everything else clean. Subtle dark green radial background. Gold strokes only occupy 5 percent of backdrop, sparse and elegant, not an all-over texture. Rounded card radius 14px, hairline green edges, no heavy glow.
